classification: SCRIPTED TWO-ARM PAIRED CONFIRMATORY OUTCOME EXPERIMENT AT 6v6. NO ROUTER. PPO OFF. GPU OFF. CPU ONLY.
authorized_by: PI direction 2026-09-19: freeze exactly 5A/1D versus 3A/3D on fresh paired 6v6 seeds at n=192, adopt the A-failure refinement, keep the primary A gate unchanged, no router, no PPO, no new composition search. Reserve the block only after this freeze, then run contracts, then spend.
RESEARCH_QUESTION: Does fixed 5A/1D recover substantial Pole-B performance relative to balanced 3A/3D while preserving the already-strong Pole-A performance within the frozen harm tolerance?

learned_specialist_history.SHARE0_6V6_TEACHER_SPECIALIST_CROSSOVER_: Delta_A +0.0078125 [-0.0703, +0.0859], Delta_B +0.0078125 [-0.0234, +0.0391], both gates fail. High absolute performance, essentially no learned specialization.

CONTEXT_THE_6V6_HISTORY_THAT_MOTIVATES_T.the_reading: The environment carries certified regime structure, but the learned specialists did not express it. 6v6 never showed the 4v4-style A-side problem: A was already strong. What was missing at 6v6 was B-side differentiation.
CONTEXT_THE_6V6_HISTORY_THAT_MOTIVATES_T.the_scripted_sweep: PYQUATICUS_6V6_ROLE_COMPOSITION_SWEEP (exploratory, scripted fixed-role controllers, cpu, no checkpoint): balanced 3A/3D wins Pole B 9.4%, while 5A/1D wins 81.2% and 6A/0D wins 89.1%. Pole A stays high (0.75 to 0.84) across 3 to 6 attackers with no distinguishable best composition.
CONTEXT_THE_6V6_HISTORY_THAT_MOTIVATES_T.the_hypothesis_this_motivates_NOT_establ: Learned policies may already play attack-heavy on B (a learned Pole-A specialist wins Pole B at about 0.95, above the best scripted composition), which would leave a B-specialist nothing to specialize toward. This is a hypothesis linking two different objects, learned policies and scripted controllers.
CONTEXT_THE_6V6_HISTORY_THAT_MOTIVATES_T.BOUNDARY_WHAT_THIS_EXPERIMENT_CANNOT_MEA: This is a SCRIPTED test. It answers whether a fixed 5A/1D beats balanced 3A/3D on B without harming A. It CANNOT measure learned specialization, cannot show that attack-heavy composition 'fixes' B specialization, and says nothing about why the learned specialists failed to differentiate. A pass must not be read as fixing specialization.
CONTEXT_THE_6V6_HISTORY_THAT_MOTIVATES_T.safest_wording_for_pole_A: Pole A maintains high absolute performance across a broad 3-to-6-attacker plateau. It does NOT prefer a particular composition; no best composition is distinguishable at n=64.

THE_FROZEN_SELECTION_RULE.why_a_rule: 5A/1D is chosen by a mechanical rule declared before any fresh seed, so no one picks whichever arm looks nicest afterward.
THE_FROZEN_SELECTION_RULE.rule: Per pole, take the argmax composition and every composition whose paired 95% win-rate interval against it contains zero. Intersect the two poles' sets. Choose the member with the highest WORST-POLE win rate (maximin). An empty intersection, a tie at an argmax, or an exact tie at the maximin ABORTS and requires a PI decision. Nothing is broken silently.
THE_FROZEN_SELECTION_RULE.implementation: experiments/run_fixed_attack_heavy_6v6_confirmation.py::derive_selection, re-derived from the sealed sweep rows and required by contract C1 to equal the values below. 9 unit tests, including the empty-intersection, argmax-tie, maximin-tie and missing-rows abort paths.

derived_and_frozen.reading: The two candidates tie EXACTLY on mean win rate, so 'best on average' cannot decide. Worst-pole win rate breaks the tie toward 5A_1D. It is attack-heavy enough to address B, sits in A's indistinguishable-best set, and retains one defender.
derived_and_frozen.argmaxes_are_derivation_record_only: 4A_2D and 6A_0D are NOT run as arms.

ARMS_AND_DESIGN.why_exactly_two_arms: PI direction. A draft of this design carried two extra descriptive arms to estimate routing headroom; they cost more compute than a larger n would and could not bound headroom tightly at this discordance, so they were dropped.
ARMS_AND_DESIGN.poles: The certified 6v6 pole pair, exactly as in the sweep. Pole B is canonical SDS_PARENT_OP7, not the 4v4 B3-3 SDS2_B3_LOCKDEF10_2V1 construction.

seed_block.registry: Reserved under FIXED_ATTACK_HEAVY_6V6_CONFIRMATION_V1 AFTER this freeze and before any episode. The executor verifies ownership and never allocates. It sets SPENT after the run.

ARMS_AND_DESIGN.episodes: 2 poles x 2 arms x 192 seeds = 768 episodes, about 2.7 hours serial at the measured 12.7 s per 6v6 episode.
ARMS_AND_DESIGN.pairing: Every seed is run on both poles under both arms. Paired differences are taken within (pole, seed).
ARMS_AND_DESIGN.reused_machinery: make_env_n, composition_roles_n, action_for_roles_n and run_episode from the sealed 6v6 sweep executor, imported and not re-implemented. Contract C3 requires them to reproduce sealed sweep rows exactly through this executor.

PRIMARY_JOINT_GATE_UNCHANGED_FROM_4V4_ST.A_may_not_be_required_to_improve: Pole A is a guardrail, not a second repair target.
PRIMARY_JOINT_GATE_UNCHANGED_FROM_4V4_ST.A_pass_meaning: A pass still means A safety is demonstrated under the preregistered criterion. The primary A gate is unchanged: UCB95(H_A) <= 0.10. Only the interpretation of a FAILURE is refined, below.

CLAIM_CEILING_PI_WORDING_ADOPTED.if_both_gates_pass: For the tested 6v6 regimes, a fixed attack-heavy composition is sufficient to recover the B-side behavioral advantage while preserving strong A-side performance.
CLAIM_CEILING_PI_WORDING_ADOPTED.what_that_sentence_is_relative_to: The balanced 3A/3D baseline. Whether per-pole routing could add value BEYOND 5A/1D is not tested here, because only two arms run. The exploratory sweep is the only evidence on that.
still_not_claimed: that team size caused any difference from 4v4
that a router is unnecessary everywhere
anything about PPO, learned coordination, or other opponents
CLAIM_CEILING_PI_WORDING_ADOPTED.cross_scale_comparison_is_descriptive_no: Because 6v6 Pole B is SDS_PARENT_OP7 while 4v4 used B3-3, any statement that 4v4 needed regime-conditioned composition and 6v6 may not is a descriptive observation, not a causal one. It could be team size, opponent construction, the size-normalized defender gate, or their interaction.
CLAIM_CEILING_PI_WORDING_ADOPTED.scripted_not_learned: This is a scripted 6v6 composition confirmation, not a learned-specialization experiment. A pass would tell us that the selected fixed composition works across the two 6v6 poles, not that the old learned pi_B problem has been solved.

FROZEN_CLAIM_BOUNDARY_POLE_B: The 6v6 composition runs use the certified 6v6 pole pair. Pole B is canonical SDS_PARENT_OP7, not the 4v4 B3-3 SDS2_B3_LOCKDEF10_2V1 construction. Therefore cross-scale differences cannot be attributed solely to team size.

CONTRACTS_BEFORE_ANY_EPISODE.C1_SELECTION_REPRODUCES_FROM_THE_SEALED_: The sealed sweep is SEALED with a passing audit, and derive_selection() re-derives exactly the values frozen above.
CONTRACTS_BEFORE_ANY_EPISODE.C2_POLES_RESOLVE_AS_CERTIFIED: Live agent counts are 6 and 6, and both poles match the 6v6 certification's recorded fields.
CONTRACTS_BEFORE_ANY_EPISODE.C3_PARITY_ANCHOR_AGAINST_THE_SEALED_SWEE: Both arms on both poles on three spent sweep seeds (12 episodes) reproduce the sealed sweep rows on 12 fields with a non-degenerate win rate, and the arm-identity invariant holds on those rows. Parity only; no new evidence.
CONTRACTS_BEFORE_ANY_EPISODE.C6_SEED_BLOCK_OWNED_AND_UNSPENT: registered to this experiment, exact range, RESERVED.
CONTRACTS_BEFORE_ANY_EPISODE.C7_AUDIT_PLAN_SEALS_A_REGISTERED_BLOCK: The real AuditPlan on synthetic rows of the exact shape, run AFTER registration, with a negative control that omits the owner and must fail exactly seed_class.
CONTRACTS_BEFORE_ANY_EPISODE.on_failure: CONTRACT_FAILURE, stop, no seed spent. Diagnose against the frozen reference before editing anything.
CONTRACTS_BEFORE_ANY_EPISODE.post_run_integrity_invariant: Every episode's role telemetry must satisfy defend_ticks == defenders x steps, attack_ticks == attackers x steps and role_switch_count == 0. Any violation yields FIXED_ATTACK_HEAVY_6V6_ARM_IDENTITY_VIOLATED with precedence over all scientific labels.

SEALING.rule_7: Must seal via experiments/run_state.py::seal with AuditPlan.experiment_id supplied.
audited_claims: paired B gain 5A_1D minus 3A_3D on Pole B
paired A harm 3A_3D minus 5A_1D on Pole A

SEALING.label_quotability: The result payload states that its label is quotable only if the record status is SEALED.

PI_DECISIONS_FROZEN_2026_09_19.n: 192 paired seeds. At n=128 the A gate fails 58% of the time even when the true harm is exactly zero, so reading every A failure as evidence that the plateau was noise would be statistically misleading. 192 buys useful precision without the diminishing return of 256.
PI_DECISIONS_FROZEN_2026_09_19.a_failure_refinement_adopted: The primary A gate is unchanged. A failure is interpreted per PREDECLARED_TERMINAL_INTERPRETATION.

planning_arithmetic_recorded_not_a_predi.reading: At n=192 a composition exactly equal to the baseline on A passes about 60% of the time. A failure is therefore still weak evidence of harm, which is why the refinement matters more than n.
planning_arithmetic_recorded_not_a_predi.winners_curse: The -0.08 row is the sweep's own estimate for 5A_1D on A and is likely inflated by selection.

PREDECLARED_TERMINAL_INTERPRETATION.precedence: Any integrity or audit failure takes precedence over every scientific label. A record whose status is AUDIT_FAILED carries no quotable label. An arm-identity violation is such an integrity failure.
PREDECLARED_TERMINAL_INTERPRETATION.FIXED_ATTACK_HEAVY_6V6_CONFIRMED: B gate PASS and A gate PASS. Fixed 5A/1D is confirmed for this 6v6 scripted comparison.
PREDECLARED_TERMINAL_INTERPRETATION.FIXED_ATTACK_HEAVY_6V6_A_SAFETY_NOT_DEMO: B PASS, UCB95(H_A) > 0.10 and LCB95(H_A) <= 0. Promising but inconclusive on A. This is NOT evidence the plateau was fake. Do NOT reopen routing on this basis alone. No promotion.
PREDECLARED_TERMINAL_INTERPRETATION.FIXED_ATTACK_HEAVY_6V6_A_HARM_DEMONSTRAT: B PASS and LCB95(H_A) > 0 with the A gate failing. The fixed composition is not safe enough. This is evidence against the fixed 5A/1D replacement and is the ONLY branch that legitimately reopens the routed-composition question.
PREDECLARED_TERMINAL_INTERPRETATION.FIXED_ATTACK_HEAVY_6V6_B_NOT_REPLICATED: B FAIL. No demonstrated advantage from 5A/1D, regardless of A. The sweep's B signal did not replicate. STOP promotion.
PREDECLARED_TERMINAL_INTERPRETATION.FIXED_ATTACK_HEAVY_6V6_ARM_IDENTITY_VIOL: An episode's role telemetry contradicts its composition. Invalid; no scientific label.
PREDECLARED_TERMINAL_INTERPRETATION.boundary_strictness: LCB95(H_A) exactly zero is not demonstrated harm. UCB95(H_A) exactly 0.10 passes. Both are pinned by unit tests of the decision function.
PREDECLARED_TERMINAL_INTERPRETATION.no_automatic_top_up: Any larger follow-up after an inconclusive result needs a NEW freeze and FRESH seeds. This block is never topped up, and its rows are never pooled with a later block unless that pooling was declared in advance.
PREDECLARED_TERMINAL_INTERPRETATION.after_any_non_confirming_result: No alternate composition, no re-analysis of this block to reach a different label, no router, no PPO.
PREDECLARED_TERMINAL_INTERPRETATION.the_distinction_that_matters: 'Failed to prove safety' and 'proved harm' are different claims.

PREDECLARED_TERMINAL_LABELS.SUPERSEDED: The authoritative terminal interpretation is PREDECLARED_TERMINAL_INTERPRETATION. It is implemented as the pure function decide() and pinned by 13 unit tests.
